build_alice_agent: build a Parlai AliceAgent that uses the ALICE AIML bot to generate rule-based replies
run_alice_act: run the AliceAgent act method to generate a reply to the last observation
test_alice_bootstrap: test the AliceAgent _load_alice method to bootstrap the AIML kernel with startup.xml
review_alice_share: review the AliceAgent share method to share the AIML kernel across agent instances
refactor_alice_init: refactor the AliceAgent __init__ to customize AIML kernel initialization or encoding settings
